title: Interface model
description: What exists outside a document: addresses the platform owns, the names prose uses for them, and the values each may take. Supplied by a pack; the authoring core never carries one.

address.description: The platform's own identifier. Opaque to the core.

role.description: input: the document receives it. output: the document writes it. internal: the platform owns it and the document may read it, but it is not a subject-matter input.

names.description: What prose calls this address. A list because prose is inconsistent. This is the only place the correspondence is written down.

values.description: For a scalar address. Mutually exclusive with fields.

type.description: For a scalar address with no enumerated values.

fields.description: For a record address. Each field carries its own value space.

allOf.$comment: A scalar address and a record address are different shapes; carrying both hides which one a writer meant.

valueSpace.description: Symbol to number. The numbers are the platform's; the core compares symbols and passes numbers through untouched.
